<jats:p>
                    Let
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                    >
                    <jats:italic>q</jats:italic>
                    and let
                    <jats:italic>G</jats:italic>
                    be the group U(
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>q</jats:italic>
                    ) or Spin
                    <jats:sub>0</jats:sub>
                    (
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>q</jats:italic>
                    ). Let
                    <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>
                    =
                    <jats:italic>LN</jats:italic>
                    be the maximal parabolic subgroup of
                    <jats:italic>G</jats:italic>
                    with Levi subgroup
                    <jats:inline-formula>$L\cong M\times U$</jats:inline-formula>
                    where
                    <jats:inline-formula>$\openup2(M,U)=\left \{ \matrix{ ({\rm GL} _q({\mathbb C}),{\rm U}(\,p-q)),\hfill \mbox { if } G={\rm U}(\,p,q), \hfill\cr ({\rm GL} ^+_q({\mathbb R}),{\rm Spin}(\,p-q)), \mbox { if } G={\rm Spin}_0(\,p,q). }\right.$</jats:inline-formula>
                    Let χ be a one-dimensional character of
                    <jats:italic>M</jats:italic>
                    and τ
                    <jats:sup>μ</jats:sup>
                    an irreducible representation of
                    <jats:italic>U</jats:italic>
                    with highest weight
                    <jats:italic>μ</jats:italic>
                    . Let
                    <jats:inline-formula>$\pi_{\chi,\mu}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    be the representation of
                    <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>
                    which is trivial on
                    <jats:italic>N</jats:italic>
                    and
                    <jats:inline-formula>$\pi_{\chi,\mu}|_L=\chi\boxtimes \tau ^\mu$</jats:inline-formula>
                    . Let
                    <jats:inline-formula>$I_{p,q}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    be the Harish-Chandra module of the induced representation
                    <jats:inline-formula>${\rm Ind}_{P}^{G} \pi_{\chi,\mu}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    . In this paper, we shall determine (i) the reducibility of
                    <jats:inline-formula>$I_{p,q}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    , (ii) the
                    <jats:italic>K</jats:italic>
                    -types of all the irreducible subquotients of
                    <jats:inline-formula>$I_{p,q}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    when it is reducible, where
                    <jats:italic>K</jats:italic>
                    is the maximal compact subgroup of
                    <jats:italic>G</jats:italic>
                    , (iii) the module diagram of
                    <jats:inline-formula>$I_{p,q}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    (from which one can read off the composition structure), and (iv) the unitarity of
                    <jats:inline-formula>$I_{p,q}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    and its subquotients. Except in the cases
                    <jats:inline-formula>$q=p-1$</jats:inline-formula>
                    and
                    <jats:inline-formula>$q=1$</jats:inline-formula>
                    ,
                    <jats:inline-formula>$I_{p,q}$</jats:inline-formula>
                    is not
                    <jats:italic>K</jats:italic>
                    -multiplicity free.
                  </jats:p>
title: Degenerate Principal Series Representations of U( p , q ) and Spin 0 ( p , q )
